notes.title: Town to City Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Greetings, Citizens!

Still on the fence about buying the game? We’re thrilled to bring you a brand new update to our demo![/b]

We have heard your feedback, and we’re happy to let you know that new towns created within this demo update will transfer over to the full game. [/h3]

Please note that starting up this new demo will mean that you will be starting completely fresh, as saves will not transfer over from the old demo. If you would like to continue on your old save on the older version of the demo, then you will be able to do so by doing the following:

[list]
[*] Right click on the Town to City demo and click ‘Properties’. 
[*] Go to ‘Betas’ and click on the drop down menu to choose which demo version you would like to play. 
[/list]

The new demo is more reflective of the final game, and we hope that you enjoy it! 

[h3][u][b]Additional Patch Notes[/b][/u][/h3]

[list]
[*] Added a shortcut to temporarily swap to eraser while doing road brushing.
[*] Added an option to not draw over existing roads while doing road brushing.
[*] Added camera edge scrolling (and an option to turn it off). 
[*] Added an option to swap the middle mouse button and right mouse button (for camera controls). 
[*] Can now place decorations on the ground closer to houses. 
[*] Removed commute happiness and replaced it with a city density based happiness.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3115220/Town_to_City/
